deathtouch.name: Deathtouch
deathtouch.text: Any amount of damage this deals to a creature, even 1, is enough to destroy that creature.

defender.name: Defender
defender.text: This creature can't attack. It can still block.

double strike.name: Double strike
double strike.text: This creature deals combat damage twice each combat: once early, together with first strike creatures, and again at the normal time.

enchant.name: Enchant
enchant.text: Tells you what an Aura can be attached to. An Aura with "Enchant creature" targets a creature when you cast it and can only be attached to a creature.

equip.name: Equip
equip.text: Equip [cost]: Pay this cost to attach the Equipment to a creature you control, moving it there if it was on another creature. You can do this only when you could cast a sorcery.

first strike.name: First strike
first strike.text: This creature deals its combat damage before creatures without first strike or double strike, so it can kill an opposing creature before that creature strikes back.

flash.name: Flash
flash.text: You may cast this spell any time you could cast an instant, even during an opponent's turn.

flying.name: Flying
flying.text: This creature can be blocked only by creatures with flying or reach. It can still block creatures that don't fly.

haste.name: Haste
haste.text: This creature can attack and use abilities with {T} in their cost on the turn it comes under your control, instead of waiting for your next turn.

hexproof.name: Hexproof
hexproof.text: This permanent or player can't be the target of spells or abilities your opponents control. You can still target it yourself.

indestructible.name: Indestructible
indestructible.text: This permanent can't be destroyed, whether by lethal damage or by effects that say "destroy." It can still be exiled, sacrificed, or lost to having 0 toughness.

intimidate.name: Intimidate
intimidate.text: This creature can be blocked only by artifact creatures and by creatures that share a color with it.

landwalk.name: Landwalk
landwalk.text: A family of abilities written as a land type plus "walk," such as islandwalk or swampwalk. The creature can't be blocked as long as the defending player controls a land of that type.

lifelink.name: Lifelink
lifelink.text: Whenever this deals damage, its controller also gains that much life.

protection.name: Protection
protection.text: Protection from [quality]: Anything with that quality can't damage, enchant, equip, block, or target this. With protection from red, red spells can't target it and red creatures can't block or damage it.

reach.name: Reach
reach.text: This creature can block creatures with flying.

shroud.name: Shroud
shroud.text: This permanent or player can't be the target of any spell or ability, including your own.

trample.name: Trample
trample.text: When this attacking creature is blocked, it needs to assign only lethal damage to its blockers. Any damage left over can be dealt to the player, planeswalker, or battle it's attacking.

vigilance.name: Vigilance
vigilance.text: Attacking doesn't cause this creature to tap, so it stays untapped and ready to block on other players' turns.

ward.name: Ward
ward.text: Ward [cost]: Whenever this permanent becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, that spell or ability is countered unless that opponent pays the cost.

banding.name: Banding
banding.text: Attackers with banding, plus up to one without it, can attack as a band that is blocked as a group. When your creature with banding blocks or is blocked, you choose how the opposing creatures' combat damage is divided among your creatures.

rampage.name: Rampage
rampage.text: Rampage N: When this creature is blocked by more than one creature, it gets +N/+N until end of turn for each blocker after the first.

cumulative upkeep.name: Cumulative upkeep
cumulative upkeep.text: At the start of each of your upkeeps, put an age counter on this permanent, then pay its upkeep cost once for each age counter on it or sacrifice it. The price grows every turn.

flanking.name: Flanking
flanking.text: Whenever a creature without flanking blocks this creature, the blocker gets -1/-1 until end of turn.

phasing.name: Phasing
phasing.text: A phased out permanent is treated as though it doesn't exist until it phases back in, right before its controller untaps on their next turn. A permanent with phasing phases out and in on alternating turns.

buyback.name: Buyback
buyback.text: Buyback [cost]: You may pay this extra cost as you cast the spell. If you do, the spell goes back to your hand instead of your graveyard when it resolves.

shadow.name: Shadow
shadow.text: This creature can be blocked only by creatures with shadow, and it can block only creatures with shadow.

cycling.name: Cycling
cycling.text: Cycling [cost]: Pay this cost and discard this card from your hand to draw a card. To cycle a card is to do this.

echo.name: Echo
echo.text: Echo [cost]: At the beginning of your first upkeep after this permanent comes under your control, pay its echo cost or sacrifice it.

horsemanship.name: Horsemanship
horsemanship.text: This creature can be blocked only by creatures with horsemanship. It can still block creatures without it.

fading.name: Fading
fading.text: Fading N: This permanent enters with N fade counters on it. At the beginning of each of your upkeeps, remove one. If you can't, sacrifice it.

kicker.name: Kicker
kicker.text: Kicker [cost]: You may pay this extra cost as you cast the spell. If you do, the spell is "kicked" and gets the bonus described on the card.

flashback.name: Flashback
flashback.text: Flashback [cost]: You may cast this card from your graveyard by paying its flashback cost instead of its mana cost. It's exiled afterward instead of returning to the graveyard.

madness.name: Madness
madness.text: Madness [cost]: If you discard this card, it goes to exile instead of your graveyard, and you may cast it right then for its madness cost. If you don't, it goes to your graveyard.

fear.name: Fear
fear.text: This creature can be blocked only by artifact creatures and black creatures.

morph.name: Morph
morph.text: Morph [cost]: You may cast this card face down for {3} as a 2/2 creature with no name or abilities. Any time you could cast an instant, you may pay its morph cost to turn it face up.

amplify.name: Amplify
amplify.text: Amplify N: As this creature enters, you may reveal any number of cards from your hand that share a creature type with it. It enters with N +1/+1 counters for each card you revealed.

provoke.name: Provoke
provoke.text: Whenever this creature attacks, you may untap a target creature the defending player controls and force it to block this creature this combat if it's able to.

storm.name: Storm
storm.text: When you cast this spell, copy it once for each other spell that was cast before it this turn. You may choose new targets for the copies.

affinity.name: Affinity
affinity.text: Affinity for [quality]: This spell costs {1} less to cast for each permanent of that kind you control. Affinity for artifacts counts your artifacts.

entwine.name: Entwine
entwine.text: Entwine [cost]: On a spell that makes you choose among modes, you may pay this extra cost to get all of the modes instead of only some.

modular.name: Modular
modular.text: Modular N: This enters with N +1/+1 counters on it. When it dies, you may put a +1/+1 counter on a target artifact creature for each +1/+1 counter it had.

sunburst.name: Sunburst
sunburst.text: This enters with one counter for each color of mana spent to cast it: +1/+1 counters if it's a creature, charge counters if it isn't.

bushido.name: Bushido
bushido.text: Bushido N: This creature gets +N/+N until end of turn whenever it blocks or becomes blocked.

soulshift.name: Soulshift
soulshift.text: Soulshift N: When this permanent dies, you may return a target Spirit card with mana value N or less from your graveyard to your hand.

splice.name: Splice
splice.text: Splice onto [quality] [cost]: As you cast a spell of that kind, you may reveal this card from your hand and pay its splice cost to add this card's text to that spell. This card stays in your hand.

offering.name: Offering
offering.text: [Quality] offering: as you cast this spell, you may sacrifice a [quality] permanent. If you do, you may cast it any time you could cast an instant, and its cost is reduced by the sacrificed permanent's mana cost.

ninjutsu.name: Ninjutsu
ninjutsu.text: Ninjutsu [cost]: pay [cost] and return an unblocked attacking creature you control to its owner's hand to put this card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking in its place.

epic.name: Epic
epic.text: After this spell resolves, you can't cast spells for the rest of the game. At the beginning of each of your upkeeps, you copy this spell (without its epic ability) and may choose new targets for the copy.

convoke.name: Convoke
convoke.text: You can tap your untapped creatures to help pay for this spell. Each creature tapped this way pays for {1} or for one mana of that creature's color.

dredge.name: Dredge
dredge.text: Dredge N: while this card is in your graveyard, if you would draw a card, you may instead mill N cards and return this card to your hand. You can't do this with fewer than N cards in your library.

transmute.name: Transmute
transmute.text: Transmute [cost]: pay [cost] and discard this card to search your library for a card with the same mana value, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. Only when you could cast a sorcery.

bloodthirst.name: Bloodthirst
bloodthirst.text: Bloodthirst N: this permanent enters with N +1/+1 counters on it if any opponent has already been dealt damage this turn. Bloodthirst X gives one counter for each damage your opponents were dealt this turn.

haunt.name: Haunt
haunt.text: When this creature dies, or when this instant or sorcery resolves, exile it haunting target creature. The card's other ability can then trigger from exile, usually when the creature it haunts dies.

replicate.name: Replicate
replicate.text: Replicate [cost]: as you cast this spell, you may pay [cost] any number of times. When you cast it, copy it once for each time you paid, and you may choose new targets for the copies.

forecast.name: Forecast
forecast.text: An ability you can activate only while this card is in your hand, only during your upkeep, and only once each turn. You reveal the card as you activate it, and it stays in your hand.

graft.name: Graft
graft.text: Graft N: this permanent enters with N +1/+1 counters on it. Whenever another creature enters, you may move a +1/+1 counter from this permanent onto that creature.

recover.name: Recover
recover.text: Recover [cost]: while this card is in your graveyard, when a creature you own dies, you may pay [cost] to return this card to your hand. If you don't pay, this card is exiled.

ripple.name: Ripple
ripple.text: Ripple N: when you cast this spell, you may reveal the top N cards of your library and cast any of them that share this spell's name without paying their mana costs. The rest go on the bottom of your library.

split second.name: Split second
split second.text: While this spell is waiting on the stack, no player can cast other spells or activate abilities, so it is very hard to respond to. Mana abilities still work, and triggered abilities still trigger.

suspend.name: Suspend
suspend.text: Suspend N: rather than cast this card from your hand, you may pay its suspend cost and exile it with N time counters. Remove one at each of your upkeeps. When the last is removed, you may play it without paying its mana cost.

vanishing.name: Vanishing
vanishing.text: Vanishing N: this permanent enters with N time counters on it. At the beginning of your upkeep, remove one. When the last time counter is removed, sacrifice the permanent.

absorb.name: Absorb
absorb.text: Absorb N: whenever a source would deal damage to this creature, N of that damage is prevented.

aura swap.name: Aura swap
aura swap.text: Aura swap [cost]: pay [cost] to trade this Aura on the battlefield for an Aura card in your hand. The new Aura becomes attached to what this one was enchanting, and this one goes to your hand.

delve.name: Delve
delve.text: You can exile cards from your graveyard to help pay for this spell. Each card exiled this way pays for {1} of its cost. Colored mana still has to be paid with mana.

fortify.name: Fortify
fortify.text: Fortify [cost]: pay [cost] to attach this Fortification to target land you control, only when you could cast a sorcery. A Fortification works like Equipment, but for lands.

frenzy.name: Frenzy
frenzy.text: Frenzy N: each time this creature attacks and no creature blocks it, it gets +N/+0 until end of turn.

gravestorm.name: Gravestorm
gravestorm.text: When you cast this spell, you get one copy of it for each permanent that went from the battlefield to a graveyard earlier this turn. You may choose new targets for the copies.

poisonous.name: Poisonous
poisonous.text: Poisonous N: each time this creature deals combat damage to a player, that player also gets N poison counters. A player with ten or more poison counters loses the game.

transfigure.name: Transfigure
transfigure.text: Transfigure [cost]: pay [cost] and sacrifice this permanent to search your library for a creature card with the same mana value and put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle. Only when you could cast a sorcery.

champion.name: Champion
champion.text: Champion a [quality]: when this permanent enters, sacrifice it unless you exile another [quality] you control. When this permanent leaves the battlefield, the exiled card returns to the battlefield.

changeling.name: Changeling
changeling.text: This card is every creature type at all times, even when it isn't on the battlefield. It counts as an Elf, a Dragon, a Zombie, and so on.

evoke.name: Evoke
evoke.text: Evoke [cost]: you may cast this spell by paying [cost] rather than its mana cost. If you do, you sacrifice it when it enters.

hideaway.name: Hideaway
hideaway.text: Hideaway N: when this permanent enters, look at the top N cards of your library, exile one face down, and put the rest on the bottom in a random order. Another ability on the card lets you play the exiled card later.

prowl.name: Prowl
prowl.text: Prowl [cost]: you may cast this spell for [cost] rather than its mana cost if a player was dealt combat damage this turn by a source you controlled that shared a creature type with this spell.

reinforce.name: Reinforce
reinforce.text: Reinforce N: pay the reinforce cost and discard this card from your hand to put N +1/+1 counters on target creature.

conspire.name: Conspire
conspire.text: As you cast this spell, you may tap two of your untapped creatures that each share a color with the spell. If you do, you copy the spell and may choose new targets for the copy.

persist.name: Persist
persist.text: When this permanent dies (goes to a graveyard from the battlefield) without any -1/-1 counters on it, it comes back to the battlefield under its owner's control with a -1/-1 counter on it.

wither.name: Wither
wither.text: A source with wither deals damage to creatures in the form of -1/-1 counters. The counters stay on the creature, unlike normal damage, which wears off at end of turn.

retrace.name: Retrace
retrace.text: You may cast this card from your graveyard by discarding a land card in addition to paying its other costs.

devour.name: Devour
devour.text: Devour N: as this enters, you may sacrifice any number of creatures. It enters with N +1/+1 counters on it for each creature sacrificed this way. Devour [quality] N works the same way with [quality] permanents.

exalted.name: Exalted
exalted.text: Each time one of your creatures attacks alone (as the only attacker), that creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn. Each permanent you control with exalted adds its own bonus.

unearth.name: Unearth
unearth.text: Unearth [cost]: pay [cost] to return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield with haste, only when you could cast a sorcery. Exile it at the beginning of the next end step or if it would leave the battlefield.

cascade.name: Cascade
cascade.text: When you cast this spell, exile cards from the top of your library one by one until you exile a nonland card with lower mana value than this spell. You may cast it without paying its mana cost. The rest go on the bottom in a random order.

annihilator.name: Annihilator
annihilator.text: Annihilator N: whenever this creature attacks, the defending player sacrifices N permanents.

level up.name: Level up
level up.text: Level up [cost]: pay [cost] to put a level counter on this permanent, only when you could cast a sorcery. With enough level counters, the creature takes on the power, toughness, and abilities in its LEVEL boxes.

rebound.name: Rebound
rebound.text: If you cast this spell from your hand, exile it as it resolves instead of putting it into your graveyard. At the beginning of your next upkeep, you may cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.

umbra armor.name: Umbra armor
umbra armor.text: If the enchanted permanent would be destroyed, instead remove all damage from it and destroy this Aura. Older cards call this totem armor.

infect.name: Infect
infect.text: A source with infect deals damage to creatures in the form of -1/-1 counters and to players in the form of poison counters. A player with ten or more poison counters loses the game.

battle cry.name: Battle cry
battle cry.text: Each time this creature attacks, every other attacking creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn. The creature with battle cry gets no bonus itself.

living weapon.name: Living weapon
living weapon.text: When this Equipment enters, you create a 0/0 black Phyrexian Germ creature token and attach the Equipment to it. The Germ survives only while something, usually the Equipment, raises its toughness above 0.

undying.name: Undying
undying.text: When this permanent dies (goes to a graveyard from the battlefield) without any +1/+1 counters on it, it comes back to the battlefield under its owner's control with a +1/+1 counter on it.

miracle.name: Miracle
miracle.text: If this is the first card you draw in a turn, you may reveal it as you draw it and then cast it for its miracle cost of [cost] instead of its mana cost.

soulbond.name: Soulbond
soulbond.text: When this creature enters, you may pair it with another unpaired creature you control. If it's still unpaired, you may pair it with a creature you control that enters later. Pairs last while you control both and usually share a bonus.

overload.name: Overload
overload.text: You may cast this spell for its overload cost of [cost] instead of its mana cost. If you do, each "target" in its text becomes "each", so it hits everything that fits and no longer targets.

scavenge.name: Scavenge
scavenge.text: Pay [cost] and exile this card from your graveyard to put +1/+1 counters on target creature equal to the exiled card's power. You can do this only at times you could cast a sorcery.

unleash.name: Unleash
unleash.text: You may have this creature enter with an extra +1/+1 counter on it. It can't block as long as it has a +1/+1 counter on it.

cipher.name: Cipher
cipher.text: As this spell resolves, you may exile it encoded on a creature you control. Whenever that creature deals combat damage to a player, its controller may cast a copy of the encoded card for free.

evolve.name: Evolve
evolve.text: Whenever a creature you control enters, if its power or its toughness is greater than this creature's, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.

extort.name: Extort
extort.text: Whenever you cast a spell, you may pay {W/B} (one white or black mana). If you do, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain life equal to the total lost.

fuse.name: Fuse
fuse.text: Found on some split cards. When you cast the card from your hand, you may cast both halves as one spell by paying both costs. Follow the left half's instructions first, then the right half's.

bestow.name: Bestow
bestow.text: You may cast this creature card for its bestow cost of [cost] as an Aura that enchants a creature. If it stops being attached to a creature, it stays on the battlefield as a creature.

tribute.name: Tribute
tribute.text: As this creature enters, an opponent you choose may have it enter with N extra +1/+1 counters. If they don't, tribute wasn't paid and the creature's other ability happens instead.

dethrone.name: Dethrone
dethrone.text: Whenever this creature attacks the player with the most life, or a player tied for the most life, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.

hidden agenda.name: Hidden agenda
hidden agenda.text: Found on conspiracy cards from Conspiracy drafts. The card starts face down in the command zone with a card name you chose in secret. Any time you have priority, you may turn it face up to reveal the name.

outlast.name: Outlast
outlast.text: Pay [cost] and tap this creature to put a +1/+1 counter on it. You can do this only at times you could cast a sorcery.

prowess.name: Prowess
prowess.text: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.

dash.name: Dash
dash.text: You may cast this creature for its dash cost of [cost] instead of its mana cost. If you do, it gains haste and returns to its owner's hand at the beginning of the next end step.

exploit.name: Exploit
exploit.text: When this creature enters, you may sacrifice a creature, which can be this one. If you do, it "exploits a creature" and cards with exploit usually reward you for that.

menace.name: Menace
menace.text: This creature can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.

renown.name: Renown
renown.text: When this creature deals combat damage to a player, if it isn't renowned yet, put N +1/+1 counters on it and it becomes renowned. It stays renowned, so this happens only once.

awaken.name: Awaken
awaken.text: You may cast this spell for its awaken cost of [cost] instead of its mana cost. If you do, also put N +1/+1 counters on target land you control. It becomes a 0/0 Elemental creature with haste and is still a land.

devoid.name: Devoid
devoid.text: This card has no color, no matter which colors of mana are in its cost.

ingest.name: Ingest
ingest.text: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, that player exiles the top card of their library.

myriad.name: Myriad
myriad.text: Whenever this creature attacks, for each opponent other than the one it's attacking, you may create a token copy of it that's tapped and attacking that player or a planeswalker they control. Exile the tokens at end of combat.

surge.name: Surge
surge.text: You may cast this spell for its surge cost of [cost] instead of its mana cost if you or a teammate has already cast another spell this turn.

skulk.name: Skulk
skulk.text: This creature can't be blocked by creatures with greater power than it has.

emerge.name: Emerge
emerge.text: You may cast this spell by sacrificing a creature and paying its emerge cost of [cost], reduced by that creature's mana value. "Emerge from [quality]" has you sacrifice that kind of permanent instead.

escalate.name: Escalate
escalate.text: Found on spells that let you choose more than one mode. Pay the escalate cost of [cost] once for each mode you choose beyond the first.

melee.name: Melee
melee.text: Whenever this creature attacks, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each opponent you attacked with a creature this combat.

crew.name: Crew
crew.text: Tap any number of other untapped creatures you control with total power N or greater to turn this Vehicle into an artifact creature until end of turn, so it can attack or block.

fabricate.name: Fabricate
fabricate.text: When this permanent enters, you may put N +1/+1 counters on it. If you don't, create N 1/1 colorless Servo artifact creature tokens.

partner.name: Partner
partner.text: In Commander, you may have two commanders instead of one if both have partner. A named version, such as Character select or Survivors, pairs only with a card that has the same named version.

undaunted.name: Undaunted
undaunted.text: This spell costs {1} less to cast for each opponent you have.

improvise.name: Improvise
improvise.text: Your artifacts can help cast this spell. Each untapped artifact you tap while casting it pays for {1} of the spell's generic mana.

aftermath.name: Aftermath
aftermath.text: Found on the second half of some split cards. You can cast that half only from your graveyard, and it's exiled once it leaves the stack.

embalm.name: Embalm
embalm.text: Pay [cost] and exile this card from your graveyard to create a token copy of it, except it's a white Zombie in addition to its other types and has no mana cost. Only at times you could cast a sorcery.

eternalize.name: Eternalize
eternalize.text: Pay [cost] and exile this card from your graveyard to create a token copy of it, except it's a 4/4 black Zombie in addition to its other types and has no mana cost. Only at times you could cast a sorcery.

afflict.name: Afflict
afflict.text: Whenever this creature becomes blocked, the defending player loses N life.

ascend.name: Ascend
ascend.text: If you control ten or more permanents, you get the city's blessing for the rest of the game. The blessing does nothing by itself, but cards with ascend get better once you have it.

assist.name: Assist
assist.text: Another player may help you cast this spell by paying for any amount of its generic mana.

jump-start.name: Jump-start
jump-start.text: You may cast this instant or sorcery from your graveyard by paying its mana cost and discarding a card as an extra cost. It's exiled afterward.

mentor.name: Mentor
mentor.text: Whenever this creature attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on target attacking creature with less power than this creature.

afterlife.name: Afterlife
afterlife.text: When this permanent is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, create N 1/1 white and black Spirit creature tokens with flying.

riot.name: Riot
riot.text: This permanent enters with your choice of an extra +1/+1 counter or haste.

spectacle.name: Spectacle
spectacle.text: You may cast this spell for its spectacle cost of [cost] instead of its mana cost if an opponent lost life this turn.

escape.name: Escape
escape.text: You may cast this card from your graveyard for its escape cost of [cost], which usually includes exiling other cards from your graveyard. A permanent cast this way "escaped" and may get a bonus for it.

companion.name: Companion
companion.text: If your starting deck meets this card's condition, you may reveal it from outside the game before the game begins. Once per game, at a time you could cast a sorcery, you may pay {3} to put it into your hand.

mutate.name: Mutate
mutate.text: Mutate [cost]: You may cast this creature for this cost, targeting a creature you own that isn't a Human. It goes on top of or under that creature, and they become one creature with the top card's stats and the abilities of both.

encore.name: Encore
encore.text: Encore [cost]: Pay this and exile the card from your graveyard, only when you could cast a sorcery. For each opponent, create a token copy with haste that must attack that player. Sacrifice the copies at the next end step.

boast.name: Boast
boast.text: Marks an activated ability that you can use only if this creature attacked this turn, and only once each turn.

foretell.name: Foretell
foretell.text: During your turn, you may pay {2} and exile this card from your hand face down. On a later turn, you may cast it from exile for its foretell cost instead of its mana cost.

demonstrate.name: Demonstrate
demonstrate.text: When you cast this spell, you may copy it. If you do, an opponent you choose also gets a copy. Each of you may choose new targets for your own copy.

daybound and nightbound.name: Daybound and nightbound
daybound and nightbound.text: Daybound is on the front of a two faced card, nightbound on the back. The front is up while it's day and the back while it's night. It becomes night after a turn whose player cast no spells, and day again after one with two or more.

disturb.name: Disturb
disturb.text: Disturb [cost]: You may cast this card from your graveyard for this cost instead of its mana cost. If you do, it enters with its back face up.

decayed.name: Decayed
decayed.text: A creature with decayed can't block. When it attacks, its controller sacrifices it at end of combat.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.text: Cleave [cost]: You may cast this spell for this cost instead of its mana cost. If you do, read its text as if every word inside square brackets were removed.

training.name: Training
training.text: Whenever this creature attacks together with at least one creature that has greater power, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. A creature "trains" when it gets a counter this way.

compleated.name: Compleated
compleated.text: Found on planeswalkers with Phyrexian mana in their cost. For each of those symbols you paid for with 2 life instead of mana, the planeswalker enters with two fewer loyalty counters.

reconfigure.name: Reconfigure
reconfigure.text: Reconfigure [cost]: Pay this cost to attach this Equipment creature to another creature you control, or to unattach it. Use it only when you could cast a sorcery. While attached, it isn't a creature.

blitz.name: Blitz
blitz.text: Blitz [cost]: You may cast this creature for this cost instead of its mana cost. If you do, it has haste, you draw a card when it dies, and you sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.

casualty.name: Casualty
casualty.text: Casualty N: As you cast this spell, you may sacrifice a creature with power N or greater. If you do, copy the spell, and you may choose new targets for the copy.

enlist.name: Enlist
enlist.text: As this creature attacks, you may tap a creature you control that isn't attacking and that has haste or has been yours since the turn began. The attacker gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the tapped creature's power.

read ahead.name: Read ahead
read ahead.text: Found on Sagas. As this Saga enters, choose one of its chapter numbers and start it with that many lore counters. It begins at that chapter, and the earlier chapters are skipped.

ravenous.name: Ravenous
ravenous.text: Found on creatures with {X} in their cost. The creature enters with X +1/+1 counters on it, and if X is 5 or more, you also draw a card when it enters.

squad.name: Squad
squad.text: Squad [cost]: As you cast this creature, you may pay this extra cost any number of times. When it enters, create a token that's a copy of it for each time you paid.

space sculptor.name: Space sculptor
space sculptor.text: An ability of one card, Space Beleren. While it's out, each creature is assigned by its controller to the alpha, beta, or gamma sector, and other abilities can then affect every creature in a chosen sector.

visit.name: Visit
visit.text: Marks an Attraction's ability that happens whenever you roll to visit your Attractions and the die result is one of the numbers lit up on that Attraction.

prototype.name: Prototype
prototype.text: Prototype [cost] and [power/toughness]: You may cast this card for the smaller cost shown. If you do, it has that cost, that cost's colors, and that power and toughness instead of its usual ones. Everything else stays the same.

living metal.name: Living metal
living metal.text: Found on Vehicles. During your turn, this Vehicle is also a creature, with no need to crew it.

more than meets the eye.name: More Than Meets the Eye
more than meets the eye.text: More Than Meets the Eye [cost]: You may cast this card converted, which means with its back face up, by paying this cost instead of its mana cost.

for mirrodin!.name: For Mirrodin!
for mirrodin!.text: When this Equipment enters, you get a 2/2 red Rebel creature token, and the Equipment is attached to that token right away.

toxic.name: Toxic
toxic.text: Toxic N: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, that player also gets N poison counters. A player with ten or more poison counters loses the game.

backup.name: Backup
backup.text: Backup N: When this creature enters, put N +1/+1 counters on target creature. If that's a different creature, it also gains the abilities printed below backup on this card until end of turn.

bargain.name: Bargain
bargain.text: As you cast this spell, you may sacrifice an artifact, enchantment, or token. If you do, the spell was "bargained" and gets the bonus its text describes.

craft.name: Craft
craft.text: Craft with [materials] [cost]: Pay the cost and exile this permanent and the materials, taken from permanents you control or your graveyard, only when you could cast a sorcery. This card returns to the battlefield with its back face up.

disguise.name: Disguise
disguise.text: Disguise [cost]: You may cast this card face down for {3} as a 2/2 creature with ward {2}. Any time you have priority, you may pay its disguise cost to turn it face up.

solved.name: Solved
solved.text: Marks a Case ability that works only once the Case is solved. A Case becomes solved at the beginning of your end step if its "To solve" condition is true, and it then stays solved.

plot.name: Plot
plot.text: Plot [cost]: During your main phase with an empty stack, you may pay this cost and exile this card from your hand. On a later turn, you may cast it from exile without paying its mana cost, with the same timing.

saddle.name: Saddle
saddle.text: Saddle N: Tap any number of other untapped creatures you control with total power N or more. This Mount becomes saddled until end of turn, which turns on abilities that need it saddled. Use it only when you could cast a sorcery.

spree.name: Spree
spree.text: A spell with spree lists several modes, each with its own extra cost. Choose one or more modes as you cast it and pay the cost of each chosen mode on top of the spell's mana cost.

freerunning.name: Freerunning
freerunning.text: Freerunning [cost]: You may cast this spell for this cost instead of its mana cost if an Assassin or a commander you control dealt combat damage to a player this turn.

gift.name: Gift
gift.text: Gift a [something]: As you cast this spell, you may promise the gift to an opponent. If you do, that player gets the named thing (a card, a Food, a tapped Fish, and so on) and your card gets the bonus its text describes.

offspring.name: Offspring
offspring.text: Offspring [cost]: You may pay this extra cost as you cast this creature. If you do, when it enters, create a token that's a copy of it, except the token is 1/1.

impending.name: Impending
impending.text: Impending N, [cost]: You may cast this for this cost instead of its mana cost. If you do, it enters with N time counters and isn't a creature until they are gone. Remove one at the beginning of each of your end steps.

exhaust.name: Exhaust
exhaust.text: Marks an activated ability that you can activate only once for as long as that permanent stays on the battlefield.

max speed.name: Max speed
max speed.text: Marks an ability that works only while your speed is 4, the highest it can go. Speed comes from cards with start your engines!

start your engines!.name: Start your engines!
start your engines!.text: If you have no speed, your speed becomes 1. Once during each of your turns, when an opponent loses life, your speed goes up by 1, to a maximum of 4. Max speed abilities work at 4.

harmonize.name: Harmonize
harmonize.text: Harmonize [cost]: You may cast this card from your graveyard for this cost. As you do, you may tap a creature you control to pay {X} less, where X is its power. Exile the card afterward.

mobilize.name: Mobilize
mobilize.text: Mobilize N: Whenever this creature attacks, create N 1/1 red Warrior creature tokens that are tapped and attacking. Sacrifice those tokens at the beginning of the next end step.

job select.name: Job select
job select.text: When this Equipment enters, you get a 1/1 colorless Hero creature token, and the Equipment is attached to that token right away.

tiered.name: Tiered
tiered.text: A spell with tiered lists several modes, each with its own extra cost. Choose exactly one mode as you cast it and pay that mode's cost on top of the spell's mana cost.

station.name: Station
station.text: Tap another untapped creature you control to put charge counters on this permanent equal to that creature's power. Use it only when you could cast a sorcery. Lines marked N+ apply while it has N or more charge counters.

warp.name: Warp
warp.text: Warp [cost]: You may cast this card from your hand for this cost instead of its mana cost. If you do, it's exiled at the beginning of the next end step, and you may cast it again from exile on a later turn.

∞ (infinity).name: ∞ (Infinity)
∞ (infinity).text: Marks an ability that works only while this permanent is harnessed. Until the permanent has been harnessed, the ability written after the ∞ symbol does nothing.

mayhem.name: Mayhem
mayhem.text: Mayhem [cost]: during a turn in which you discarded this card, you may cast it from your graveyard for [cost] instead of its mana cost. With no cost listed, you may simply play it from your graveyard that turn.

web-slinging.name: Web-slinging
web-slinging.text: You may cast this spell for [cost] instead of its mana cost if you also return a tapped creature you control to its owner's hand.

firebending.name: Firebending
firebending.text: Firebending N: whenever this creature attacks, add N red mana. That mana stays in your pool until end of combat instead of draining away between steps.

sneak.name: Sneak
sneak.text: During your declare blockers step, you may cast this spell for [cost] if you also return an unblocked attacker you control to its owner's hand. A permanent cast this way enters tapped and attacking.

increment.name: Increment
increment.text: Whenever you cast a spell, if the mana you spent on it is greater than this creature's power or greater than its toughness, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.

paradigm.name: Paradigm
paradigm.text: This spell is exiled as it resolves. The first time a spell with this name resolves for you, you get a copy at the start of each of your first main phases for the rest of the game, and you may cast it for free.

power-up.name: Power-up
power-up.text: Marks an activated ability you can use only once. If this permanent entered this turn, the ability's cost is reduced by the permanent's mana cost.

teamwork.name: Teamwork
teamwork.text: Teamwork N: when you cast this spell, you may also tap creatures you control whose power adds up to N or more as an optional extra cost. If you do, the spell gets the bonus its text describes.

storied.name: Storied
storied.text: Once you control three or more permanents that are artifacts, legendary, and/or Sagas, you have an enduring story for the rest of the game. Other abilities on these cards check for it.

beam me up.name: Beam me up
beam me up.text: You may cast this instant or sorcery from your graveyard for [cost] if you also return a creature you control to its owner's hand. If you do, the card is exiled when it leaves the stack.

affinitycycling.name: Affinitycycling
affinitycycling.text: Pay [cost] and discard this card from your hand to search your library for a card with affinity, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

augment.name: Augment
augment.text: From the Unstable joke set. Pay [cost] and reveal this card from your hand to combine it with a host creature on the battlefield. You can do this only when you could cast a sorcery.

basic landcycling.name: Basic landcycling
basic landcycling.text: Pay [cost] and discard this card from your hand to search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

choose a background.name: Choose a Background
choose a background.text: A Commander deck building ability. You may have two commanders instead of one if one is this card and the other is a legendary Background enchantment.

commander ninjutsu.name: Commander ninjutsu
commander ninjutsu.text: Pay [cost] and return an unblocked attacker you control to its owner's hand to put this card from your hand or the command zone onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.

daybound.name: Daybound
daybound.text: On the front face of a double faced card. Whenever it's night, this permanent transforms to its back face. Day turns to night after a turn in which the active player cast no spells.

desertwalk.name: Desertwalk
desertwalk.text: This creature can't be blocked as long as the defending player controls a Desert.

doctor's companion.name: Doctor's companion
doctor's companion.text: A Commander deck building ability. You may have two commanders if this card is one and the other is a legendary creature whose only creature types are Time Lord and Doctor.

double agenda.name: Double agenda
double agenda.text: On conspiracy cards from Conspiracy drafts. You start with the card face down in the command zone and secretly name two different cards for it. You may turn it face up later to reveal the names.

double team.name: Double team
double team.text: Digital only. When this creature attacks, if it isn't a token, you conjure a duplicate of it into your hand. Then both cards permanently lose this ability.

forestcycling.name: Forestcycling
forestcycling.text: Pay [cost] and discard this card from your hand to search your library for a Forest card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. It finds any land with the Forest type, not only basic Forests.

forestwalk.name: Forestwalk
forestwalk.text: This creature can't be blocked as long as the defending player controls a Forest.

friends forever.name: Friends forever
friends forever.text: A partner variant for Commander. You may have two commanders instead of one if both of them have this same ability.

halflingcycling.name: Halflingcycling
halflingcycling.text: Pay [cost] and discard this card from your hand to search your library for a Halfling card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

hexproof from.name: Hexproof from
hexproof from.text: Hexproof from [quality]: this permanent can't be the target of spells with that quality, or of abilities from sources with that quality, that your opponents control. The quality is often a color.

intensity.name: Intensity
intensity.text: Digital only. A number tracked on a card. It begins at the card's starting intensity N, sets how big the card's effect is, and goes up permanently each time the card intensifies.

islandcycling.name: Islandcycling
islandcycling.text: Pay [cost] and discard this card from your hand to search your library for an Island card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. It finds any land with the Island type, not only basic Islands.

islandwalk.name: Islandwalk
islandwalk.text: This creature can't be blocked as long as the defending player controls an Island.

landcycling.name: Landcycling
landcycling.text: Pay [cost] and discard this card from your hand to search your library for a land card of the stated kind, such as a basic land (any land card if no kind is stated), reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

legendary landwalk.name: Legendary landwalk
legendary landwalk.text: This creature can't be blocked as long as the defending player controls a legendary land.

megamorph.name: Megamorph
megamorph.text: You may cast this card face down as a 2/2 creature for {3}. Any time you have priority, you may turn it face up by paying [cost]; when you do, it gets a +1/+1 counter.

mountaincycling.name: Mountaincycling
mountaincycling.text: Pay [cost] and discard this card from your hand to search your library for a Mountain card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. It finds any land with the Mountain type, not only basic Mountains.

mountainwalk.name: Mountainwalk
mountainwalk.text: This creature can't be blocked as long as the defending player controls a Mountain.

multikicker.name: Multikicker
multikicker.text: Multikicker [cost]: as you cast this spell, you may pay this extra cost as many times as you like. The spell's effect grows with the number of times it was kicked.

nightbound.name: Nightbound
nightbound.text: On the back face of a double faced card. Whenever it's day, this permanent transforms to its front face. Night turns to day after a turn in which the active player cast two or more spells.

nonbasic landwalk.name: Nonbasic landwalk
nonbasic landwalk.text: This creature can't be blocked as long as the defending player controls a nonbasic land.

partner with.name: Partner with
partner with.text: Partner with [name]: in Commander, this card and the named card can be your two commanders. Also, when this permanent enters, a target player may search their library for the named card and put it into their hand.

plainscycling.name: Plainscycling
plainscycling.text: Pay [cost] and discard this card from your hand to search your library for a Plains card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. It finds any land with the Plains type, not only basic Plains.

plainswalk.name: Plainswalk
plainswalk.text: This creature can't be blocked as long as the defending player controls a Plains.

slivercycling.name: Slivercycling
slivercycling.text: Pay [cost] and discard this card from your hand to search your library for a Sliver card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

specialize.name: Specialize
specialize.text: Digital only. Pay [cost], choose a color, and discard a card of that color or a basic land of its type to permanently turn this creature into its version for that color. Activate only as a sorcery.

swampcycling.name: Swampcycling
swampcycling.text: Pay [cost] and discard this card from your hand to search your library for a Swamp card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. It finds any land with the Swamp type, not only basic Swamps.

swampwalk.name: Swampwalk
swampwalk.text: This creature can't be blocked as long as the defending player controls a Swamp.

typecycling.name: Typecycling
typecycling.text: A cycling variant written as [type]cycling [cost]. Pay the cost and discard this card from your hand to search your library for a card of that type, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

wizardcycling.name: Wizardcycling
wizardcycling.text: Pay [cost] and discard this card from your hand to search your library for a Wizard card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

activate.name: Activate
activate.text: To use an activated ability (written as "cost: effect"): pay its cost and put the ability on the stack. Normally only the permanent's controller can do this, and only while they have priority.

attach.name: Attach
attach.text: To move an Aura, Equipment, or Fortification onto a permanent or player so that it affects them. It can only be attached to something it could legally enchant, equip, or fortify.

behold.name: Behold
behold.text: To behold a [quality], either reveal a [quality] card from your hand or choose a [quality] permanent you control. Nothing moves; you only show that you have one.

cast.name: Cast
cast.text: To take a card from where it is (usually your hand), put it on the stack as a spell, and pay its costs. The spell then waits to resolve, which gives other players a chance to respond.

counter.name: Counter
counter.text: To cancel a spell or ability that is on the stack, so it never resolves and has no effect. A countered spell goes to its owner's graveyard, and the costs paid for it are not refunded.

create.name: Create
create.text: To put a token with the stated characteristics onto the battlefield. Tokens are not cards; they are markers that count as permanents for as long as they stay on the battlefield.

destroy.name: Destroy
destroy.text: To move a permanent from the battlefield to its owner's graveyard. A permanent with indestructible can't be destroyed, and regeneration can replace the destruction.

discard.name: Discard
discard.text: To put a card from your hand into your graveyard. You choose which card unless the effect says the discard is random or lets another player choose.

double.name: Double
double.text: To make a number twice as large. Doubling power gives a creature +X/+0, where X is its power at that moment. Doubling life, counters, or mana adds as much as is already there. Doubled damage is dealt as twice the amount.

triple.name: Triple
triple.text: To make a creature's power, toughness, or both three times as large. Tripling power gives the creature +X/+0, where X is twice its power at that moment.

exchange.name: Exchange
exchange.text: To swap two things, such as control of two permanents or two players' life totals. Each side takes the other's place at the same time. If the whole swap can't happen, none of it does.

exile.name: Exile
exile.text: To move a card or permanent to the exile zone, an area set apart from the rest of the game. An exiled card is not in the graveyard and usually stays in exile unless an effect says otherwise.

fight.name: Fight
fight.text: When two creatures fight, each deals damage equal to its power to the other. This is not combat damage, and nothing happens if either creature is gone by the time they would fight.

goad.name: Goad
goad.text: A goaded creature must attack each combat if able, and must attack a player other than the one who goaded it if able. Goading lasts until that player's next turn unless the card gives another duration.

investigate.name: Investigate
investigate.text: To create a Clue token. A Clue is a colorless artifact that you can sacrifice by paying {2} to draw a card.

mill.name: Mill
mill.text: To mill N cards, put the top N cards of your library into your graveyard. If your library has fewer cards than that, you mill as many as you can.

play.name: Play
play.text: To play a land is to put it onto the battlefield from your hand, normally once per turn during your own main phase. To play a card means to play it as a land or cast it as a spell, whichever applies.

regenerate.name: Regenerate
regenerate.text: The next time this permanent would be destroyed this turn, it stays on the battlefield instead: it becomes tapped, all damage on it is removed, and it leaves combat if it was attacking or blocking.

reveal.name: Reveal
reveal.text: To show a card to all players. The card stays in the zone it is in; revealing it doesn't move it.

sacrifice.name: Sacrifice
sacrifice.text: To move a permanent you control from the battlefield to its owner's graveyard. This is not destruction, so indestructible and regeneration don't stop it. You can only sacrifice your own permanents.

scry.name: Scry
scry.text: To scry N, look at the top N cards of your library, then put any number of them on the bottom of your library and the rest back on top, in any order you like.

search.name: Search
search.text: To look through all the cards in a zone, usually your library, and find a card that fits the description. When you search a hidden zone for a card with a stated quality, you may choose to find nothing.

shuffle.name: Shuffle
shuffle.text: To randomize the order of the cards in a library, or in a face down pile, so that no player knows where any card is.

surveil.name: Surveil
surveil.text: To surveil N, look at the top N cards of your library, then put any number of them into your graveyard and the rest back on top of your library in any order.

tap and untap.name: Tap and untap
tap and untap.text: To tap a permanent, turn it sideways to show it has been used, often to attack or to pay a cost. To untap it, turn it upright again. Only an untapped permanent can be tapped, and only a tapped one can be untapped.

transform.name: Transform
transform.text: To turn a double faced permanent over so its other face is up. It stays the same permanent and keeps its counters and attachments. Single faced permanents can't transform. "Transformed" means with the back face up.

convert.name: Convert
convert.text: To turn a double faced permanent over so its other face is up. It works exactly like transforming; Transformers cards use this word when they switch between their robot and vehicle faces.

fateseal.name: Fateseal
fateseal.text: To fateseal N, look at the top N cards of an opponent's library, then put any number of them on the bottom of that library and the rest back on top in any order.

clash.name: Clash
clash.text: To clash with an opponent, you each reveal the top card of your library, and each of you may then put that card on the bottom. You win the clash if your card has the higher mana value.

planeswalk.name: Planeswalk
planeswalk.text: In a Planechase game, to move to a new plane: put the face up plane or phenomenon card on the bottom of its owner's planar deck, then turn the top card of your planar deck face up.

set in motion.name: Set in motion
set in motion.text: In an Archenemy game, the archenemy sets a scheme in motion by taking the top card of their scheme deck and turning it face up. The scheme's effect then happens.

abandon.name: Abandon
abandon.text: In an Archenemy game, to abandon an ongoing scheme is to turn it face down and put it on the bottom of its owner's scheme deck, which ends its effect.

proliferate.name: Proliferate
proliferate.text: Choose any number of permanents and players that have counters on them, then give each of them one more counter of each kind it already has.

detain.name: Detain
detain.text: A detained permanent can't attack or block, and its activated abilities can't be activated. This lasts until the next turn of the player who detained it.

populate.name: Populate
populate.text: Choose a creature token you control and create a new token that is a copy of it. If you control no creature tokens, nothing happens.

monstrosity.name: Monstrosity
monstrosity.text: Monstrosity N: if this creature isn't monstrous yet, put N +1/+1 counters on it and it becomes monstrous. It stays monstrous, so this works only once, and other abilities may check for it.

vote.name: Vote
vote.text: Each player, starting with a named player and going in turn order, picks one of the listed options. The card then counts the votes to decide what happens.

bolster.name: Bolster
bolster.text: Bolster N: put N +1/+1 counters on the creature you control with the least toughness. If several are tied for least, you choose one of them.

manifest.name: Manifest
manifest.text: To put a card onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature with no name or abilities. If it is a creature card, you may turn it face up any time you have priority by paying its mana cost.

support.name: Support
support.text: Support N: put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to N target creatures. When a permanent has this, the targets must be other creatures.

meld.name: Meld
meld.text: Combine the two cards of a meld pair: both are put onto the battlefield back face up and joined, forming one oversized permanent. Only the two cards that name each other can meld.

exert.name: Exert
exert.text: When you exert a permanent, it won't untap during your next untap step. Most often you may exert a creature as it attacks to get a bonus.

explore.name: Explore
explore.text: The exploring creature's controller reveals the top card of their library. A land goes to their hand. Otherwise the creature gets a +1/+1 counter and the card stays on top or goes to the graveyard.

assemble.name: Assemble
assemble.text: Put a Contraption onto the battlefield from your separate Contraption deck. Contraptions come from the Unstable set, and Steamflogger Boss is the only regular card that mentions assembling one.

adapt.name: Adapt
adapt.text: Adapt N: if this permanent has no +1/+1 counters on it, put N +1/+1 counters on it. If it already has one or more, nothing happens.

amass.name: Amass
amass.text: Amass [type] N: put N +1/+1 counters on an Army creature you control, and it becomes a [type] too. If you control no Army, first create a 0/0 black [type] Army creature token.

learn.name: Learn
learn.text: You may discard a card to draw a card. If you don't, you may instead reveal a Lesson card you own from outside the game and put it into your hand.

venture into the dungeon.name: Venture into the dungeon
venture into the dungeon.text: Enter the first room of a dungeon you pick from outside the game or, if you have one in progress, move your marker to its next room. You get that room's effect. You complete a dungeon once its last room's effect has finished.

connive.name: Connive
connive.text: The conniving creature's controller draws a card, then discards a card. If the discarded card isn't a land, put a +1/+1 counter on that creature. Connive N uses N cards and gives one counter per nonland card discarded.

open an attraction.name: Open an Attraction
open an attraction.text: Turn the top card of your Attraction deck face up and put it onto the battlefield under your control. Attractions are artifacts kept in their own side deck, used only by cards that open them.

roll to visit your attractions.name: Roll to visit your Attractions
roll to visit your attractions.text: Roll a six sided die. Each Attraction you control with that number lit up is visited, which triggers its visit ability. If you control an Attraction, you also do this as your first main phase begins each turn.

incubate.name: Incubate
incubate.text: Incubate N: create an Incubator artifact token with N +1/+1 counters on it. You can pay {2} to turn it over into a 0/0 Phyrexian artifact creature, which keeps those counters.

the ring tempts you.name: The Ring tempts you
the ring tempts you.text: Choose a creature you control to carry the Ring. It becomes legendary and can't be blocked by creatures with greater power. The second, third and fourth temptations each add another ability to your Ring emblem.

face a villainous choice.name: Face a villainous choice
face a villainous choice.text: The player picks one of the two options written on the card, then everything in that option happens. They may pick an option they can't fully carry out; in that case as much of it as possible happens.

time travel.name: Time travel
time travel.text: For each permanent you control with a time counter on it and each suspended card you own, you may either add one time counter to it or remove one from it.

discover.name: Discover
discover.text: Discover N: exile cards from the top of your library until you hit a nonland card with mana value N or less. Cast it for free or put it into your hand. The rest go on the bottom of your library in a random order.

cloak.name: Cloak
cloak.text: Put a card onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature with ward {2}. If it's a creature card, you may turn it face up any time you have priority by paying its mana cost.

collect evidence.name: Collect evidence
collect evidence.text: Collect evidence N: exile cards from your graveyard whose mana values add up to N or more. It is usually a cost, and many cards give a bonus if evidence was collected.

suspect.name: Suspect
suspect.text: A suspected creature has menace and can't block. It stays suspected until it leaves the battlefield or an effect says it is no longer suspected.

forage.name: Forage
forage.text: Exile three cards from your graveyard or sacrifice a Food. Foraging is usually a cost you pay to get an effect.

manifest dread.name: Manifest dread
manifest dread.text: Look at the top two cards of your library. Put one onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature and the other into your graveyard. If the face down card is a creature card, you can turn it face up for its mana cost.

endure.name: Endure
endure.text: Endure N: the creature's controller either puts N +1/+1 counters on that creature or creates an N/N white Spirit creature token instead.

harness.name: Harness
harness.text: Makes this permanent harnessed, which turns on the ability written after its ∞ symbol. Once harnessed, it stays that way until it leaves the battlefield.

airbend.name: Airbend
airbend.text: Exile the chosen permanent or spell. For as long as that card stays exiled, its owner may cast it for {2} instead of its mana cost.

earthbend.name: Earthbend
earthbend.text: Earthbend N: target land you control becomes a 0/0 creature with haste that is still a land, and gets N +1/+1 counters. When it dies or is exiled, it returns to the battlefield tapped under your control.

waterbend.name: Waterbend
waterbend.text: Waterbend [cost]: pay that cost. For each generic mana in it, you may tap an untapped artifact or creature you control instead of paying that mana.

blight.name: Blight
blight.text: Blight N: put N -1/-1 counters on a creature you control. Where blighting is a cost or a choice, you can't pick it unless you control a creature to put the counters on.

heal.name: Heal
heal.text: Remove the damage marked on a permanent, so it no longer counts toward destroying it. Regenerating a creature, for example, heals all damage on it.

recruit.name: Recruit
recruit.text: Draw a card, then discard a card. If the discarded card isn't a land, create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token.

empower jace.name: Empower Jace
empower jace.text: Empower Jace N: put N loyalty counters on a Jace planeswalker token you control. If you have none, first create a blue Jace token with 0 loyalty that can spend 1 loyalty to surveil 1 or 3 loyalty to draw a card.

assimilate.name: Assimilate
assimilate.text: Gain control of the permanent and put a +1/+1 counter on it. It becomes a Borg artifact creature. A card assimilated from another zone enters the battlefield under your control the same way.

conjure.name: Conjure
conjure.text: Digital only (MTG Arena). Creates a brand new copy of the named card out of nothing and puts it where the effect says, such as your hand, your library or the battlefield.

draft from a spellbook.name: Draft from a spellbook
draft from a spellbook.text: Digital only (MTG Arena). You are shown three random cards from a fixed list tied to the card, called its spellbook. Pick one and it is created where the effect says, usually in your hand.

face a dilemma.name: Face a dilemma
face a dilemma.text: You face a dilemma each time you choose one or more modes for a spell or ability that offers a choice, such as a "Choose one" card. Some cards reward you for doing so.

heist.name: Heist
heist.text: Digital only (MTG Arena). Look at three random nonland cards from an opponent's library and exile one face down. You may cast it while it stays exiled, spending mana of any type.

incorporate.name: Incorporate
incorporate.text: Digital only (MTG Arena). A card that incorporates [cost] has that cost added to its own mana cost for the rest of the game, so it costs more to cast and also takes on the colors of the added mana.

prepared.name: Prepared
prepared.text: A creature with a prepare spell (the small second card frame in its text box) can become prepared. While it's prepared, you may cast a copy of that spell. Doing so makes the creature unprepared again.

seek.name: Seek
seek.text: Digital only (MTG Arena). Put a random card that fits the description from your library into your hand. Your library isn't revealed or shuffled.

tap.name: Tap
tap.text: Turn a permanent sideways to show it has been used, often to pay a cost such as {T}. Only an untapped permanent can be tapped, and it normally stays tapped until your next untap step.

untap.name: Untap
untap.text: Turn a tapped permanent upright again so it can be used once more. Your permanents normally untap at the start of each of your turns.

actualize.name: Actualize
actualize.text: Digital only (MTG Arena). Marks abilities that care about spells you cast that didn't start the game in your deck, such as cards you conjured or took from an opponent.

adamant.name: Adamant
adamant.text: Marks a bonus a spell gets if at least three mana of the kind it names (one color, or colorless) was spent to cast it.

addendum.name: Addendum
addendum.text: Marks an extra effect you get only if you cast the spell during a main phase of your own turn, instead of on another turn or in the middle of combat.

alliance.name: Alliance
alliance.text: Marks an ability that triggers whenever another creature you control enters, whether you cast it, made a token or put it onto the battlefield some other way.

battalion.name: Battalion
battalion.text: Marks an ability that triggers whenever this creature and at least two other creatures attack at the same time.

battlefront.name: Battlefront
battlefront.text: Marks an ability that counts the opponents you attacked this turn. Attacking more opponents in the same turn makes the effect bigger or the cost smaller.

bloodrush.name: Bloodrush
bloodrush.text: Marks an ability of a creature card that you use from your hand: pay the cost and discard the card to give a target attacking creature a boost equal to that card's power and toughness, often with an extra ability.

celebration.name: Celebration
celebration.text: Marks an ability that works, or gets a bonus, only if two or more nonland permanents entered the battlefield under your control this turn.

channel.name: Channel
channel.text: Marks an ability you activate from your hand: pay the cost and discard the card to get the effect, instead of casting the card.

chroma.name: Chroma
chroma.text: Marks an effect that counts the mana symbols of one color in the mana costs of a group of cards, such as permanents you control or cards in your graveyard.

cohort.name: Cohort
cohort.text: Marks an ability of an Ally creature that you activate by tapping it together with another untapped Ally you control.

constellation.name: Constellation
constellation.text: Marks an ability that triggers whenever an enchantment you control enters. On most cards that includes the card with the ability itself.

converge.name: Converge
converge.text: Marks an effect that scales with how many different colors of mana you spent to cast the spell, from zero up to five.

corrupted.name: Corrupted
corrupted.text: Marks an ability that works, or gets a bonus, only once an opponent has three or more poison counters.

council's dilemma.name: Council's dilemma
council's dilemma.text: Marks a vote between two named options. Starting with you, each player votes, and the effect happens once for each vote, so both outcomes can happen in different amounts.

council’s dilemma.name: Council’s dilemma
council’s dilemma.text: Marks a vote between two named options. Starting with you, each player votes, and the effect happens once for each vote, so both outcomes can happen in different amounts.

coven.name: Coven
coven.text: Marks an ability that works, or gets a bonus, only if you control three or more creatures with different powers, for example a 1/1, a 2/2 and a 3/3.

covercast.name: Covercast
covercast.text: Digital only (MTG Arena). Marks an ability that triggers whenever you cast another instant or sorcery spell that five or more mana was spent to cast.

delirium.name: Delirium
delirium.text: Marks an ability that works, or gets a bonus, only if the cards in your graveyard have four or more card types among them, such as creature, land, instant and sorcery.

descend.name: Descend
descend.text: You descend each time a permanent card is put into your graveyard from anywhere. Cards ask whether, or how many times, you descended this turn; the card doesn't have to still be in your graveyard.

descend 4.name: Descend 4
descend 4.text: Marks an ability that works, or gets a bonus, only if there are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard. Permanent cards are artifact, battle, creature, enchantment, land and planeswalker cards.

descend 8.name: Descend 8
descend 8.text: Marks an ability that works, or gets a bonus, only if there are eight or more permanent cards in your graveyard. Permanent cards are artifact, battle, creature, enchantment, land and planeswalker cards.

disappear.name: Disappear
disappear.text: Marks an ability that works, or gets a bonus, only if a permanent you controlled left the battlefield this turn, for example by dying, being sacrificed or exiled, or returning to a hand.

domain.name: Domain
domain.text: Marks an effect that counts the basic land types among lands you control. The types are Plains, Island, Swamp, Mountain and Forest, so the count goes up to five.

eerie.name: Eerie
eerie.text: Marks an ability that triggers whenever an enchantment you control enters and whenever you fully unlock a Room, meaning both of its doors are now unlocked.

eminence.name: Eminence
eminence.text: Marks an ability of a commander that works while that card is on the battlefield and also while it is in the command zone, even before you have cast it.

enrage.name: Enrage
enrage.text: Marks an ability that triggers whenever the creature is dealt damage, in combat or from any other source.

fateful hour.name: Fateful hour
fateful hour.text: Marks an ability that works, or gets a bonus, only if you have 5 or less life.

fathomless descent.name: Fathomless descent
fathomless descent.text: Marks an effect that counts the permanent cards in your graveyard: artifacts, battles, creatures, enchantments, lands and planeswalkers. The more there are, the bigger the effect.

federation.name: Federation
federation.text: Marks an effect that counts the different creature types among the creatures you control that aren't Borg. A more varied crew gives a bigger effect.

ferocious.name: Ferocious
ferocious.text: Marks an ability that works, or gets a bonus, only if you control a creature with power 4 or greater.

flurry.name: Flurry
flurry.text: Marks an ability that triggers whenever you cast your second spell in a turn. It can happen on any player's turn, but only once each turn.

formidable.name: Formidable
formidable.text: Marks an ability that works, or gets a bonus, only if the creatures you control have total power 8 or greater.

grandeur.name: Grandeur
grandeur.text: Marks an ability of a legendary permanent that you activate by discarding another card with the same name, which gives spare copies in your hand a use.

hellbent.name: Hellbent
hellbent.text: Marks an ability that works, or gets a bonus, only if you have no cards in your hand.

hero's reward.name: Hero's Reward
hero's reward.text: Appears only on enemy cards in the Theros challenge decks (Face the Hydra, Battle the Horde, Defeat a God). Marks the reward the players get when that card leaves the battlefield or is put into a graveyard.

heroic.name: Heroic
heroic.text: Marks an ability that triggers whenever you cast a spell that targets this creature. Spells cast by other players, and abilities that target it, don't count.

imprint.name: Imprint
imprint.text: Marks an ability that exiles a card and links it to this permanent. The permanent's other abilities then use that exiled card, for example by copying it or borrowing its traits.

infusion.name: Infusion
infusion.text: Marks an ability that works, or gets a bonus, only if you gained life this turn.

inspired.name: Inspired
inspired.text: Marks an ability that triggers whenever the creature becomes untapped, most often during your untap step after it attacked.

join forces.name: Join forces
join forces.text: Marks an effect that lets each player, starting with you, pay any amount of mana. The effect grows with the total mana everyone paid.

kinfall.name: Kinfall
kinfall.text: From a Mystery Booster playtest card, not legal in regular play. Marks an ability that triggers whenever a creature that shares a creature type with this creature enters under your control.

kinship.name: Kinship
kinship.text: Marks an upkeep ability: at the beginning of your upkeep you may look at the top card of your library, and if it shares a creature type with this creature you may reveal it to get an effect.

landfall.name: Landfall
landfall.text: Marks an ability that triggers whenever a land you control enters. Playing your land for the turn counts, and so does a land put onto the battlefield by a spell or ability.

landship.name: Landship
landship.text: From a Mystery Booster playtest card, not legal in regular play. Marks an upkeep ability that lets you look at the top card of your library and reveal it for a reward if it's a land.

legacy.name: Legacy
legacy.text: From Mystery Booster playtest cards, not legal in regular play. Marks an ability that has you permanently mark or write on the physical card, so the change stays for later games.

lieutenant.name: Lieutenant
lieutenant.text: Marks an ability that works, or gets a bonus, only while you control your commander, meaning it is on the battlefield under your control.

magecraft.name: Magecraft
magecraft.text: Marks an ability that triggers whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell. Each copy counts, so copying a spell three times triggers it three times.

metalcraft.name: Metalcraft
metalcraft.text: Marks an ability that works, or gets a bonus, only if you control three or more artifacts.

morbid.name: Morbid
morbid.text: Marks an ability that works, or gets a bonus, only if a creature died this turn. Any creature counts, no matter who controlled it.

opus.name: Opus
opus.text: Marks an ability that triggers whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell and gives a bigger or extra effect if five or more mana was spent to cast that spell.

pack tactics.name: Pack tactics
pack tactics.text: Marks an ability that triggers when the creature attacks, but only if the creatures you attacked with this combat have total power 6 or greater.

paradox.name: Paradox
paradox.text: Marks an ability that rewards you for casting spells from anywhere other than your hand, such as from your graveyard, from exile, or from the top of your library.

parley.name: Parley
parley.text: Marks an ability that has each player reveal the top card of their library. You get a bonus based on the cards revealed (usually one for each nonland card), and each player draws a card.

radiance.name: Radiance
radiance.text: Marks a spell or ability that affects its target and also each other creature that shares a color with it (one card does the same with enchantments instead of creatures).

raid.name: Raid
raid.text: Marks an ability that checks whether you attacked this turn. If you did, it triggers, can be activated, or gives a better effect.

rally.name: Rally
rally.text: Marks an ability that triggers whenever the creature or another Ally enters the battlefield under your control, usually giving creatures you control a bonus until end of turn.

renew.name: Renew
renew.text: Marks an ability you activate while the card is in your graveyard: pay the cost and exile the card to put one or more counters on a creature. You can do this only when you could cast a sorcery.

repartee.name: Repartee
repartee.text: Marks an ability that triggers whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell that targets a creature.

revolt.name: Revolt
revolt.text: Marks an ability that checks whether a permanent you controlled left the battlefield this turn (it died, was sacrificed, was exiled, returned to hand, and so on). If one did, you get the effect or a better one.

rulebreaker.name: Rulebreaker
rulebreaker.text: Marks an ability of a commander that changes a deck building rule for its own deck, such as allowing certain cards outside its color identity or removing the deck size limit.

secret council.name: Secret council
secret council.text: Marks an ability where each player votes in secret (for a player, a permanent, or a named option) and all votes are revealed at once. What happens depends on how the votes fall.

seek out.name: Seek out
seek out.text: Marks an ability that triggers whenever you draw your second card each turn.

spell mastery.name: Spell mastery
spell mastery.text: Marks a spell that gets a stronger or extra effect if there are two or more instant and/or sorcery cards in your graveyard.

strange new worlds.name: Strange new worlds
strange new worlds.text: Marks an ability that counts the differently named lands you control. The more lands with different names you have, the bigger the effect or the lower the cost.

strive.name: Strive
strive.text: Marks a spell that can have any number of targets but costs extra mana for each target beyond the first.

survival.name: Survival
survival.text: Marks an ability that triggers at the beginning of your second main phase if the creature is tapped, which usually means it attacked and lived through combat.

sweep.name: Sweep
sweep.text: Marks a spell that lets you return any number of lands of one basic type (such as Plains) you control to their owner's hand. Its effect grows with the number of lands returned.

tempting offer.name: Tempting offer
tempting offer.text: Marks a spell that gives you an effect and then lets each opponent choose to get the same effect. For each opponent who accepts, you get the effect again.

threshold.name: Threshold
threshold.text: Marks an ability that turns on, can be activated, or gets stronger only if there are seven or more cards in your graveyard.

underdog.name: Underdog
underdog.text: Marks a bonus you get if you have lost a game earlier in the current match. It appears only on a Mystery Booster playtest card, which isn't legal in regular play.

undergrowth.name: Undergrowth
undergrowth.text: Marks an ability whose effect counts the creature cards in your graveyard. The more you have, the stronger it is.

valiant.name: Valiant
valiant.text: Marks an ability that triggers the first time each turn the creature becomes the target of a spell or ability you control.

vivid.name: Vivid
vivid.text: Marks an ability that counts the colors among permanents you control (up to five). More colors means a bigger effect or a lower cost.

void.name: Void
void.text: Marks an ability that checks whether a nonland permanent left the battlefield this turn or a spell was warped this turn. If either happened, you get the effect or a better one.

will of the council.name: Will of the council
will of the council.text: Marks an ability where each player votes openly, starting with you and going in turn order, for a named option or for an object. The choice with the most votes decides what happens.

will of the planeswalkers.name: Will of the Planeswalkers
will of the planeswalkers.text: Marks a vote used in Planechase games: starting with you, each player votes for planeswalk or chaos. If planeswalk gets more votes, you move to the next plane. Otherwise the current plane's chaos ability triggers.

blood.name: Blood
blood.text: A Blood token is a colorless artifact. You can pay {1}, tap it, discard a card, and sacrifice it to draw a card.

clue.name: Clue
clue.text: A Clue token is a colorless artifact. You can pay {2} and sacrifice it to draw a card. The investigate action creates one.

cursed role.name: Cursed Role
cursed role.text: A colorless Aura enchantment token (a Role) attached to a creature. The enchanted creature has base power and toughness 1/1.

food.name: Food
food.text: A Food token is a colorless artifact. You can pay {2}, tap it, and sacrifice it to gain 3 life.

gold.name: Gold
gold.text: A Gold token is a colorless artifact. You can sacrifice it, with no other cost, to add one mana of any color.

heartwood.name: Heartwood
heartwood.text: A Heartwood token is a red and green artifact you can tap to add {R} or {G}. It isn't sacrificed, so it can make mana every turn.

incubator.name: Incubator
incubator.text: An Incubator token is a colorless artifact with two faces, created with some +1/+1 counters on it. Pay {2} to transform it into a 0/0 Phyrexian artifact creature that keeps those counters.

junk.name: Junk
junk.text: A Junk token is a colorless artifact. Tap and sacrifice it to exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn. You can do this only when you could cast a sorcery.

lander.name: Lander
lander.text: A Lander token is a colorless artifact. Pay {2}, tap it, and sacrifice it to search your library for a basic land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.

map.name: Map
map.text: A Map token is a colorless artifact. Pay {1}, tap it, and sacrifice it to have a target creature you control explore. You can do this only when you could cast a sorcery.

monster role.name: Monster Role
monster role.text: A colorless Aura enchantment token (a Role) attached to a creature. The enchanted creature gets +1/+1 and has trample.

mutagen.name: Mutagen
mutagen.text: A Mutagen token is a colorless artifact. Pay {1}, tap it, and sacrifice it to put a +1/+1 counter on a target creature. You can do this only when you could cast a sorcery.

powerstone.name: Powerstone
powerstone.text: A Powerstone token is a colorless artifact you can tap for {C} (one colorless mana). That mana can't be spent to cast a nonartifact spell, but it can pay for artifact spells and for abilities.

role token.name: Role token
role token.text: A Role is a colorless Aura enchantment token attached to a creature that changes it in a small way. If a creature has more than one Role controlled by the same player, only the newest one stays.

royal role.name: Royal Role
royal role.text: A colorless Aura enchantment token (a Role) attached to a creature. The enchanted creature gets +1/+1 and has ward {1}, so an opponent's spell or ability that targets it is countered unless they pay {1}.

shard.name: Shard
shard.text: A Shard token is a colorless enchantment. You can pay {2} and sacrifice it to scry 1, then draw a card.

sorcerer role.name: Sorcerer Role
sorcerer role.text: A colorless Aura enchantment token (a Role) attached to a creature. The enchanted creature gets +1/+1 and has an ability that lets its controller scry 1 whenever it attacks.

treasure.name: Treasure
treasure.text: A Treasure token is a colorless artifact. You can tap and sacrifice it to add one mana of any color.

vibranium.name: Vibranium
vibranium.text: A Vibranium token is a colorless artifact with indestructible that you can tap for {C} (one colorless mana). That mana can't be spent to cast a nonartifact spell.

virtuous role.name: Virtuous Role
virtuous role.text: A colorless Aura enchantment token (a Role) attached to a creature. The enchanted creature gets +1/+1 for each enchantment controlled by the Role's controller, counting the Role itself.

walker.name: Walker
walker.text: A Walker token is a 2/2 black Zombie creature token named Walker. It has no abilities.

wicked role.name: Wicked Role
wicked role.text: A colorless Aura enchantment token (a Role) attached to a creature. The enchanted creature gets +1/+1. When the Role is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, each opponent loses 1 life.

young hero role.name: Young Hero Role
young hero role.text: A colorless Aura enchantment token (a Role) attached to a creature. Whenever the enchanted creature attacks, if its toughness is 3 or less, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
